title: Sequim Botanical Garden

services.name: Sequim Botanical Garden
services.desc: Give the gift of a growing civic investment and gorgeous garden blooms for the holidays by donating to the Sequim Botanical Garden Society at the Sequim Farmers Market on December 23 at Guy Cole Center at Carrie Blake Community Park from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Ready to plant peony roots are a $10 donation and for two peony roots at a $30 donation you receive a bonus free one year membership to the Sequim Botanical Garden Society. You will also receive peony planting and care instructions with your roots. Amy Hall of the Peony Farm generously donated these peony roots ready for planting intended for fundraising efforts and growing in the Terrace Garden which is by the band shell at Carrie Blake
